scope: Extends the scalar/if subset with explicitly pinned module sources; not a full QLIE runtime

module_contracts.implemented: sub accepts a literal target and optional file selector; omitted selector, unquoted self and string-valued self remain in current module; non-self string result resolves through the host-supplied catalog
unsupported: raw empty field to nil mapping

module_contracts.implemented: Every source is bound by logical path, relative physical file and SHA-256; all variants retained; differing bytes require an explicit source choice
module_contracts.identical_aliases: Deterministic source provenance choice only, not proof of native mount precedence or reload behavior

module_contracts.implemented: A new candidate frame retains caller program snapshot and next record; zero-argument ret restores that source and caller frame
module_contracts.source_policy: Immutable pinned snapshots within a run; no writes to imported files
module_contracts.preprocessing: Includes in a catalog-loaded program are rejected; complete native include/line/macro pipeline is not recovered

module_contracts.implemented: Logical Windows separators map to slash; ASCII case folds only; Data keys preserve Unicode scalar distinctions; unsafe paths and symlinks rejected

unchanged_limits: Integer-only scalar declarations, object/table behavior, ordinary text, media, animation and saves remain outside supported execution
